definitions.explanation: An aircraft powered by jet engines.

examples.japanese: ジェット{機|き}で{海外|かいがい}に{行|い}く。
examples.english: To go overseas by jet plane.

examples.japanese: ジェット{機|き}が{空|そら}を{飛|と}んでいる。
examples.english: A jet plane is flying in the sky.

examples.japanese: {初|はじ}めてジェット{機|き}に{乗|の}ったのは{十歳|じっさい}のときだった。
examples.english: The first time I rode on a jet plane was when I was ten years old.

notes:
ジェット{機|き} combines the loanword ジェット (jet) with {機|き} (machine; aircraft).

RELATED TERMS:
- {飛行機|ひこうき} (airplane - general term)
- {旅客機|りょかくき} (passenger plane)
- {戦闘機|せんとうき} (fighter jet)
- プロペラ{機|き} (propeller plane)

The suffix {機|き} is used for many types of machines and aircraft:
- {洗濯機|せんたくき} (washing machine)
- {掃除機|そうじき} (vacuum cleaner)
- ヘリコプター / {回転翼機|かいてんよくき} (helicopter)
